summary: AerCap Holdings N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, AerCap Funding Designated Activity Company, priced $1.5 billion of senior notes: $750 million of 5.500% notes due 2030 and $750 million of 5.875% notes due 2033. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by AerCap and certain subsidiaries. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including aircraft asset acquisition, investment, financing or refinancing, and debt repayment. Citigroup, Mizuho, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Santander and Truist are joint book-running managers. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown, not a special situation.
